messages:
June: Brief recap from today's DR rehearsal (14:00 UTC): failover succeeded but we hit three pain points worth tracking: DNS TTL surprises, restore isolation ambiguity, and runbook edit drift. Posting concise follow-ups and owners.

Raj: Observed ~30s of uneven routing while DNS TTLs expired; our cutover assumes 5s DNS TTL which isn't set on external caches. We should add a preflight to set low TTLs for test domains and track a metric for DNS-resolve tail-time.

Marco: During the restore test one of the steps referenced a stale IAM role name. Runbook text didn't link to the canonical service-account. We need authoritative references in the runbook and a "verify-credentials" step that fails early.

Ava: Also noticed backup retention notes are inconsistent between infra/playbooks and billing docs; that's caused confusion on which snapshot to use. I'll consolidate and add a short table in the runbook.

ops-bot: dr-rehearsal-2026-04-28: completed; auto-created follow-ups INF-530, INF-531, INF-532.

June: Action items (please ack and update if dates don't work):

1) DNS TTL preflight and resolution metric
Owner: Raj
Due: 2026-05-06
Ticket: INF-530
What: add preflight step to set test domain TTL=2s, run `dig +time=2 +tries=1` loop to measure tail, and add Grafana panel for DNS-resolve p99.

2) Runbook credential linking & verify step
Owner: Marco
Due: 2026-04-30
Ticket: INF-531
What: add canonical SA references, include `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy` verify snippet and fail-if-missing check.

3) Backup retention reconciliation doc + snapshot-table in runbook
Owner: Ava
Due: 2026-04-27
Ticket: INF-532
What: consolidate retention policy, mark recommended snapshot age for restores, and add an example `aws s3 cp` checksum validation command.

June: Minimal runbook preflight snippets to include under a new "cutover-preflight" section: 
```
# quick dns tail measurement
for i in {1..6}; do dig +short app-test.redwood.net | xargs -n1 -I{} date +%s && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" http://{}:80/health || echo fail; sleep 1; done
# verify SA exists
gcloud iam service-accounts describe dr-restore@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# checksum verify
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/latest.sql.gz - | sha256sum
```

Raj: ack, will add dashboard and gating rule: block final traffic-shift if DNS tail p99 > 10s.

Marco: ack, will update playbooks/DR-README and add verify snippet. Will link INF-531.

Ava: ack, will PR the retention table and ping finance for billing alignment.

June: Thanks. Scheduling a short follow-up sync next Tue to validate INF-530..INF-532 changes and run the TTL test. Closing thread now; tickets hold the detailed tasks. :white_check_mark:
